ActionCodec2: A Streaming Action Tokenizer VLA

streaming action tokenizer geometric covering Set-BPE VLA models state feedback

简要说明：ActionCodec2 是一种用于VLA模型的非神经流式动作分词器，能在误差范围内逐步输出动作，在仿真和真实机器人基准上优于先前的分词器，并可作为VLM智能体的直接控制接口。

TLDR: ActionCodec2 is a non-neural streaming action tokenizer for VLA models that incrementally releases actions within error bounds, outperforming prior tokenizers on simulation and real-robot benchmarks and acting as a control interface for VLM agents.

Abstract: Most action tokenizers for autoregressive vision language action (VLA) models compress motion into chunks that must be decoded in full before their actions become executable. We introduce ActionCodec2, a non-neural streaming tokenizer that releases actions incrementally while keeping trajectory reconstruction error within a prescribed tolerance. Its encoder quantizes each step relative to the decoder's reconstructed state, so the selected motion primitive corrects residual error rather than allowing errors from independently quantized increments to accumulate. Finding the smallest such primitive set is a geometric covering problem; we derive the exact minimum for translation and constant-factor-tight bounds for rotation. Set-BPE then losslessly merges co-occurring primitive symbols across coordinates and neighboring steps, without a fixed coordinate ordering. A universal version fitted on 20k hours of data from 24 embodiments averages 8.8 tokens per second for 15 Hz end-effector motion on this corpus. With the same VLA backbone, ActionCodec2 outperforms the compared tokenizers on three simulation benchmarks and in zero-shot real-robot evaluation. Its streaming representation allows policies to incorporate state feedback within an action chunk, substantially improving performance over open-loop execution under randomized dynamics, external disturbances, and moving objects. The same tokens also can serve as a direct control interface for VLM agents, which compose successful action sequences into reusable macros. These agent-built macros reduce control decisions and thinking-token usage across attempts and transfer to a held-out task. More results are available at https://zibindong.github.io/actioncodec2-page/

摘要（中文）：大多数用于自回归视觉语言动作（VLA）模型的动作分词器会将动作压缩为多个块，这些块必须在动作可执行之前被完整解码。我们提出了ActionCodec2，一种非神经流式分词器，它能够增量式地释放动作，同时将轨迹重建误差保持在预定容差范围内。其编码器相对于解码器的重建状态对每一步进行量化，因此所选的运动基元用于修正残差，而不是让独立量化增量产生的误差不断累积。寻找最小的此类基元集合是一个几何覆盖问题；我们推导出了平移的精确最小值以及旋转的常数因子紧界。随后，Set-BPE在无需固定坐标顺序的情况下，跨坐标和相邻步骤无损合并共现的基元符号。一个通用版本在来自24种具身的2万小时数据上拟合，在语料库上对15 Hz末端执行器动作平均产生每秒8.8个token。在相同的VLA骨干网络下，ActionCodec2在三个模拟基准测试以及零样本真实机器人评估中均优于所对比的分词器。其流式表示允许策略在动作块内纳入状态反馈，在随机动力学、外部扰动和移动物体条件下，相较于开环执行性能显著提升。同样的token还可作为VLM智能体的直接控制接口，使其能够将成功的动作序列组合为可复用的宏。这些智能体构建的宏减少了多次尝试中的控制决策和思维token使用量，并可迁移到保留任务中。更多结果请访问 https://zibindong.github.io/actioncodec2-page/

Authors: Zibin Dong, Yicheng Liu, Shiduo Zhang, Tianyuan Yuan, Baijun Ye, Jinqiu Wang, Hang Zhao

Bind-WAM: Binding-Uncertainty-Guided Selective Future Imagination in World Action Models WorldModel

selective future imagination binding uncertainty world action models robot learning language-object binding

简要说明：Bind-WAM提出了一种基于绑定不确定性的路由器，选择性触发世界动作模型中的未来想象，在减少计算成本的同时保持任务性能，并在仿真和真实实验中验证。

TLDR: Bind-WAM introduces a binding-uncertainty-guided router that selectively triggers future imagination in World Action Models for robot control, reducing computational cost while maintaining task performance in simulation and real-world experiments.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) can improve robot learning by jointly predicting future visual states and actions, but generating a visual future at every replanning step is expensive and sometimes unnecessary. This raises a critical question: when should a robot policy imagine the future? In this paper, we propose Bind-WAM, a binding-uncertainty-guided WAM for selective future imagination. Bind-WAM introduces language-object binding uncertainty, selectively invoking joint future-action generation when the current observation does not support stable task-relevant action generation. An offline labeling pipeline uses complete demonstrations and action context to identify task-relevant objects and detect reference mismatch, invisibility, and identity drift. The resulting pseudo-labels supervise a lightweight router that predicts binding uncertainty from the current observation and language instruction. At inference, a shared WAM policy invokes selective future imagination according to the predicted uncertainty and its change between consecutive replanning steps. Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that Bind-WAM can establish binding uncertainty as a strong, interpretable signal for selective future imagination.

摘要（中文）：世界行动模型（WAMs）通过联合预测未来的视觉状态和动作，能够提升机器人学习的效果，但在每一步重新规划时都生成视觉未来既代价高昂，有时也并无必要。这引出了一个关键问题：机器人策略应在何时想象未来？在本文中，我们提出Bind-WAM，一种基于绑定不确定性引导的WAM，用于选择性未来想象。Bind-WAM引入了语言-物体绑定不确定性，在当前的观测不足以支持稳定任务相关动作生成时，选择性地调用联合未来-动作生成。离线标注流程利用完整示范和动作上下文来识别任务相关物体，并检测参考不匹配、不可见性以及身份漂移问题。由此产生的伪标签用于监督一个轻量级路由器，该路由器根据当前观测和语言指令预测绑定不确定性。在推理阶段，共享的WAM策略根据预测的不确定性及其在连续重新规划步骤之间的变化，调用选择性未来想象。仿真和真实世界实验表明，Bind-WAM能够将绑定不确定性确立为一种强有力且可解释的信号，用于指导选择性未来想象。

Authors: Chenhao Qiu, Shuyi Chen, Songen Gu, Shufeng Nan, Tianyu Wang, Siyu Lin, Yifan Li, Bingwen Zhu, Yanwei Fu

GraSLA: A Lightweight Spatial-Language-Action Model with Grasp Hypotheses as Geometric Priors Manipulation

language-conditioned manipulation grasp hypotheses imitation learning spatial-language-action model bidirectional cross-attention

简要说明：GraSLA是一种轻量级空间-语言-动作模型，通过双向交叉注意力将6自由度抓取假设作为几何先验与空间和语言基础模型集成，在LIBERO上达到99.30%的平均成功率。

TLDR: GraSLA is a lightweight spatial-language-action model that integrates 6-DoF grasp hypotheses as geometric priors with spatial and language foundation models via bidirectional cross-attention, achieving 99.30% average success on LIBERO.

Abstract: This paper focuses on improving the behavioral diversity and effectiveness of language-conditioned manipulation policies trained through imitation learning. Recently, continuous-action policies have become mainstream in robotic manipulation, but the lack of diverse demonstrations tends to restrict their behavioral diversity. For grasping, a fundamental subtask of manipulation, 6-DoF grasp detection provides diverse grasp hypotheses, but open-loop execution constrains responsiveness in dynamic environments. This motivates us to combine the diversity of grasp hypotheses with the adaptability of continuous-action policies. To this end, we propose GraSLA, a lightweight and effective spatial-language-action model with grasp hypotheses as geometric priors. In particular, we employ spatial and language foundation models to encode scene geometry and task semantics, and integrate them with grasp hypotheses through bidirectional cross-attention for continuous action prediction. On LIBERO, GraSLA achieves an average success rate of 99.30%.

摘要（中文）：本文聚焦于提升通过模仿学习训练的语言条件操作策略的行为多样性与有效性。近年来，连续动作策略已成为机器人操作领域的主流方法，但演示数据的多样性不足往往限制了其行为多样性。对于抓取这一操作中的基础子任务，六自由度抓取检测能够提供多样化的抓取假设，然而开环执行方式在动态环境中限制了其响应能力。这促使我们将抓取假设的多样性与连续动作策略的适应性相结合。为此，我们提出GraSLA，一种以抓取假设为几何先验的轻量级且高效的空间-语言-动作模型。具体而言，我们利用空间与语言基础模型对场景几何和任务语义进行编码，并通过双向交叉注意力机制将其与抓取假设相融合，以实现连续动作预测。在LIBERO基准上，GraSLA达到了99.30%的平均成功率。

Authors: Jibao Yuan, Zixiang Zhao, Wensong Xu, Siqi Lu, Shaofei Chen

Recover, Don't Just Continue: Learning from Feedback for Physical Failure Understanding and Correction VLA

failure understanding corrective planning multimodal LLM evaluation-first SFT prefix distribution distillation

简要说明：该论文提出了Embodied-Corrector，一个训练框架，通过Judge-Cause监督增强多模态大模型分析物理执行失败的能力，并通过Sub-Fine监督生成纠正计划；采用评估优先的SFT和在线前缀分布（OPD）蒸馏来处理自生成前缀错误，在冻结VLA或GPT-5.5执行下提升了复合任务成功率。

TLDR: The paper introduces Embodied-Corrector, a training framework that augments multimodal LLMs with the ability to analyze physical execution failures (through Judge-Cause supervision) and generate corrective plans (Sub-Fine), using evaluation-first SFT and Online Prefix-Distribution (OPD) distillation to handle self-generated prefix errors, improving composite task success with frozen VLA or GPT-5.5 execution.

Abstract: Multimodal large language models are regarded as the cognitive foundation of embodied intelligence, but planning from instructions alone cannot make them reliable. During execution, actions deviate from intended effects, constrained by the embodiment and environment. An embodied brain must understand why execution deviates, identify what can be reliably realized, and revise decisions using interaction experience. These correspond to causal failure localization, capability-constrained adaptation, and experience-driven revision. Current embodied foundation models largely lack these capabilities. To address this, we introduce Embodied-Corrector. We construct failure-recovery data by injecting perturbations at subtask boundaries of successful trajectories, replaying affected subtasks, and keeping failures that are observable from public evidence and recoverable from the current state. We align actions, consequences, failure causes, and recoveries into Judge-Cause-Sub-Fine supervision. Training uses evaluation-first SFT: the model learns Judge and Cause first, then Sub and Fine conditioned on accurate prefixes. Since deployment uses self-generated prefixes, evaluation errors propagate into recovery planning, and response-level rewards are too coarse to locate affected planning tokens. We therefore use OPD to internalize the planning distribution under accurate prefixes into that under self-generated ones: the model generates plans from self-generated prefixes, while a contrastive forward pass with accurate prefixes compares token probabilities to reinforce or suppress planning tokens. At deployment, this branch is removed. Experiments show stronger failure analysis and corrective planning: with a frozen VLA, composite task success improves by 6.1 percentage points; with fixed GPT-5.5 execution, manipulation and navigation tasks improve by 13.9 percentage points.

摘要（中文）：多模态大语言模型被视为具身智能的认知基础，但仅靠指令进行规划并不能使其可靠。在执行过程中，动作会偏离预期效果，受到具身形态和环境的约束。具身大脑必须理解执行为何偏离预期，识别哪些目标能够可靠实现，并利用交互经验修正决策。这些分别对应因果故障定位、能力约束适应和经验驱动修正。当前的具身基础模型大多缺乏这些能力。为此，我们提出了Embodied-Corrector。通过在成功轨迹的子任务边界注入扰动、重放受影响的子任务，并保留可从公开证据观测且可从当前状态恢复的故障，我们构建了故障恢复数据。我们将动作、后果、故障原因和恢复过程对齐为Judge-Cause-Sub-Fine监督信号。训练采用评估优先的SFT策略：模型先学习Judge和Cause，再在准确前缀条件下学习Sub和Fine。由于部署时使用自生成前缀，评估误差会传播到恢复规划中，而响应级奖励过于粗糙，难以定位受影响的规划词元。因此，我们使用OPD将准确前缀下的规划分布内化为自生成前缀下的规划分布：模型从自生成前缀生成规划，同时通过带准确前缀的对比前向传播比较词元概率，以强化或抑制规划词元。部署时移除该分支。实验表明，该方法实现了更强的故障分析和修正规划能力：在冻结VLA的条件下，复合任务成功率提升6.1个百分点；在固定GPT-5.5执行的条件下，操作和导航任务分别提升13.9个百分点。

Authors: Miao Pan, Kaixiang Yao, Xiaohe Zhou, Xu Wang, Qinfeng Li, Wenqi Zhang, Xuhong Zhang

EMS-Nav: Embodied Multi-Scale Navigation VLN

multi-scale navigation open-vocabulary mapping on-device language-guided navigation region hierarchy

简要说明：EMS-Nav 提出了一种受生物学启发的、以区域为中心的多尺度导航框架，通过围绕局部区域组织感知和空间理解，实现高效的在线设备端建图与语言目标执行，在多尺度导航任务中达到最先进水平。

TLDR: EMS-Nav introduces a biologically inspired, region-centric multi-scale navigation framework for embodied robots, enabling efficient online, on-device mapping and language-goal execution by organizing perception and spatial understanding around local regions, achieving state-of-the-art results in multi-scale navigation.

Abstract: Industrial inspection robots must reach work areas and specific equipment. These destinations span spatial scales from regions to objects, so robots must relate each target to its surroundings to interpret the task and determine where to go. Existing methods support multi-scale navigation through rich environment representations, but at substantial computational and storage cost. These costs limit deployment where wireless coverage is incomplete and robots must rely on onboard computation to keep navigating. We introduce EMS-Nav, a biologically inspired multi-scale navigation framework for online, on-device operation. Its core innovation is to organize perception, spatial understanding, and navigation around regions, making local spaces the basic units of both environmental understanding and computation. EMS-Nav groups objects and their relationships into functionally meaningful spaces and builds a hierarchy from local areas to the broader environment. This organization supports efficient map construction alongside the interpretation and execution of language goals at different scales. In multi-scale navigation experiments, EMS-Nav achieves the highest success rates across all four target categories: objects, rooms, regions, and specific instances. It outperforms state-of-the-art open-vocabulary mapping and navigation methods, improving overall first-attempt success by 9.39 percentage points over the strongest baseline while reducing mapping overhead and language-model input size. Local deployment in real indoor environments further demonstrates its applicability to on-device embodied navigation. By establishing regions as the organizing basis for perception, spatial understanding, and language-guided action, EMS-Nav provides a system that combines multi-scale understanding with computational efficiency to support diverse language goals on resource-constrained robots.

摘要（中文）：工业检测机器人必须抵达工作区域和特定设备。这些目的地跨越从区域到物体的空间尺度，因此机器人必须将每个目标与其周围环境关联起来，以理解任务并确定行进方向。现有方法通过丰富的环境表征支持多尺度导航，但代价是高昂的计算和存储开销。这些开销限制了其在无线覆盖不完整环境中的部署，此时机器人必须依赖机载计算持续导航。我们提出EMS-Nav，一种受生物学启发的多尺度导航框架，适用于在线、设备端运行。其核心创新在于围绕区域组织感知、空间理解和导航，将局部空间作为环境理解和计算的基本单元。EMS-Nav将物体及其关系分组为功能上有意义的空间，并构建从局部区域到更广泛环境的层级结构。该组织方式支持高效的地图构建，同时实现不同尺度语言目标的理解与执行。在多尺度导航实验中，EMS-Nav在全部四类目标（物体、房间、区域和特定实例）上均取得最高成功率。它超越了最先进的开放词汇映射和导航方法，在最强基线上将整体首次尝试成功率提升了9.39个百分点，同时降低了映射开销和语言模型输入规模。在真实室内环境中的本地部署进一步证明了其在设备端具身导航中的适用性。通过将区域确立为感知、空间理解和语言引导行动的组织基础，EMS-Nav提供了一个将多尺度理解与计算效率相结合的系统，以支持资源受限机器人上的多样化语言目标。

Authors: Zenghui Yang, Xinan Wang, Danyang Li, Zhe Xu, Zheng Yang, Jingao Xu, Qiang Ma

What Makes a VLA Reactive? A Study of Execution Strategies for Dynamic Manipulation VLA

VLA reactive execution dynamic manipulation prediction horizon asynchronous inference

简要说明：本文研究了执行策略（如预测和执行范围、推理模式以及轨迹连续性）如何影响预训练 VLA 模型在动态操作任务中的反应性，表明执行流程与策略本身同样重要。

TLDR: This paper investigates how execution strategies, such as prediction and execution horizons, inference mode, and trajectory continuity, affect the reactivity of a pretrained VLA model in dynamic manipulation tasks, showing that the execution pipeline is as important as the policy itself.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models predict chunks of future actions, and when objects move, those chunks go stale before they are executed. We study what makes a pretrained VLA reactive, using \pihalf{} on two dynamic simulation benchmarks and three real-robot tasks. We vary the prediction and execution horizons, compare synchronous and asynchronous inference, test methods that deliver actions sooner or keep successive chunks continuous, and adapt the policy with motion cues and latent-space reinforcement learning. The best prediction horizon is about one second, and the best execution horizon depends on the checkpoint. Short horizons help more with asynchronous execution, and methods that keep the trajectory continuous outperform those that only reduce latency. Adapting the policy repairs targeted failures, but on the conveyor task changing the execution horizon gained as much. Reactivity depends on the execution pipeline as much as on the policy, so both should be evaluated together.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型预测未来动作片段，但当物体移动时，这些片段在执行前就已过时。我们研究了预训练VLA模型的响应性因素，在两项动态仿真基准和三项真实机器人任务中使用\pihalf{}进行评估。我们变化预测和执行的时域范围，比较同步与异步推理，测试提前输出动作或保持连续片段连贯性的方法，并通过运动线索和潜在空间强化学习来调整策略。最佳预测时域约为1秒，最佳执行时域则取决于检查点。较短的时域在异步执行中更为有效，而保持轨迹连续性的方法优于仅降低延迟的方法。策略调整能修复特定失效情况，但在传送带任务中，改变执行时域所获得的收益同样显著。响应性既取决于执行管线，也取决于策略本身，因此两者应共同评估。

Authors: Zhuoyue Li, Zhendong Han, Pankhuri Vanjani, Wenting Li, Rudolf Lioutikov

FloCOS: Predicting Compact Forward Occupancy Sets of Surrounding Vehicles via Conditional Flow Matching AutonomousDriving

forward occupancy prediction conditional flow matching convex polygons trajectory optimization Waymo Open Motion Dataset

简要说明：FloCOS 利用条件流匹配预测周围车辆紧凑且高覆盖的前向占用集，将其表示为凸多边形并集，可直接用于轨迹优化，在 Waymo 和真实车辆上验证。

TLDR: FloCOS uses conditional flow matching to predict compact, high-coverage forward occupancy sets for surrounding vehicles, representing them as unions of convex polygons for direct use in trajectory optimization, validated on Waymo and real vehicles.

Abstract: Existing methods for predicting surrounding vehicles' forward occupancy may under-approximate the ground-truth occupancy, exposing the ego vehicle to collision risk, or produce overly conservative regions that unnecessarily restrict feasible space and cause planning failures. To address these issues, we propose FloCOS, a conditional flow-matching framework that predicts compact forward occupancy sets with high occupancy coverage. FloCOS represents the forward occupancy set as a time-varying union of half-space convex polygons parameterized by temporal basis coefficients. Conditional flow matching captures the conditional distribution of these coefficients to govern the temporal evolution of the convex components, trained under coverage and union-area losses that penalize missed occupancy and excess area. For downstream trajectory optimization, the predicted nonconvex union is directly incorporated into hyperplane-based collision-avoidance constraints. Evaluations on the Waymo Open Motion Dataset show that FloCOS generates compact forward occupancy sets with high coverage and achieves a higher interaction completion rate than evaluated baselines. Real-world vehicle experiments further confirm its ability to support collision-free planning in interactive scenarios.

摘要（中文）：现有预测周围车辆前方占用区域的方法可能低估真实占用情况，使自车面临碰撞风险，或者产生过于保守的区域，不必要地限制可行空间并导致规划失败。为解决这些问题，我们提出了FloCOS，一种条件流匹配框架，能够预测具有高占用覆盖率且紧凑的前方占用集合。FloCOS将前方占用集合表示为以时间基系数参数化的半空间凸多边形时变并集。条件流匹配捕获这些系数的条件分布，以控制凸组件的时间演化，并在覆盖率损失和并集面积损失的训练下，分别惩罚漏检占用和多余面积。在下游轨迹优化中，预测得到的非凸并集被直接纳入基于超平面的碰撞规避约束。在Waymo开放运动数据集上的评估表明，FloCOS生成的紧凑前方占用集合具有高覆盖率，且交互完成率高于所对比的基线方法。实车实验进一步验证了其在交互场景中支持无碰撞规划的能力。

Authors: Chuansheng Dong, Yinxiao Zhan, Zongdian Li, Peng Hou, Jin Wang, Jiayu Fan

Low-Cost Mobile Bimanual Manipulation for Long-Horizon Toilet Cleaning VLA

mobile bimanual manipulation Vision-Language-Action models long-horizon task low-cost robot platform real-world demonstrations

简要说明：本文介绍了一种低成本移动双臂机器人平台，用于长时程马桶清洁任务，并评测了多种VLA模型，发现π0表现最佳。

TLDR: This paper presents a low-cost mobile bimanual robot platform for long-horizon toilet cleaning and benchmarks several VLA models, finding that π0 achieves the best performance.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promising capabilities for robot manipulation, but their performance on accessible mobile bimanual platforms remains underexplored. We present a low-cost and reproducible mobile bimanual platform integrating two LeRobot SO-101 manipulators with a TurtleBot 4 and a LeRobot-ROS 2 software stack. Using long-horizon toilet cleaning as a case study, we collect 250 real-world demonstrations and evaluate $π_0$, $π_{0.5}$, SmolVLA, and GR00T under the same embodiment and task conditions. We further evaluate variants using SARM-derived task-progress signals and short-term MEM observation history. Among the evaluated models, $π_0$ performs best, achieving 60% strict and 70% relaxed autonomous success, increasing to 90% with limited human intervention. In contrast, the evaluated progress- and memory-augmented variants do not improve their corresponding baselines. Our results demonstrate the feasibility of long-horizon mobile bimanual manipulation on accessible hardware while highlighting remaining challenges in reliable VLA deployment. Project website: https://so101-turtlebot4.github.io/mobile-bimanual-cleaning/

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作中展现出良好潜力，但其在可及的双臂移动平台上的性能仍未得到充分探索。我们提出了一种低成本且可复现的移动双臂平台，集成两个LeRobot SO-101机械臂、一个TurtleBot 4以及一套LeRobot-ROS 2软件栈。以长时程卫生间清洁为案例，我们采集了250条真实世界演示数据，并在相同的具身与任务条件下对$π_0$、$π_{0.5}$、SmolVLA和GR00T进行了评估。进一步，我们评估了使用SARM派生的任务进度信号和短期MEM观测历史的变体模型。在所评估的模型中，$π_0$表现最佳，实现了60%的严格自主成功率和70%的宽松自主成功率，在有限的人工干预下可提升至90%。相比之下，所评估的进度增强和记忆增强变体未能超越其对应的基线模型。我们的结果证明了在可及硬件上实现长时程移动双臂操作的可行性，同时也凸显了VLA可靠部署中仍存在的挑战。项目网站：https://so101-turtlebot4.github.io/mobile-bimanual-cleaning/

Authors: Sven Schreiber, Bernard Burdiek, Lasse Huber-Saffer, Yung-Hui Li, Donglin Chen, Shang-Ching Liu, Jianwei Zhang

BiPOP: Partial-Order Planning for Long-Horizon Bimanual Robotic Manipulation Manipulation

bimanual manipulation partial-order planning LLM planning spatio-temporal coordination long-horizon tasks

简要说明：BiPOP 将大语言模型与时间偏序规划相结合，通过显式建模时空约束和并行执行来协调长期双手操作任务，在仿真和真实双臂机器人上优于纯LLM和ReAct式规划器。

TLDR: BiPOP couples LLMs with temporal partial-order planning to coordinate long-horizon bimanual manipulation, explicitly modeling spatio-temporal constraints and parallel execution, outperforming LLM-only and ReAct-style planners in simulation and on a real bimanual robot.

Abstract: Bimanual robotic manipulation is versatile, yet its central challenge lies not only in executing dexterous motion with each hand, but also in coordinating the two arms for long-horizon manipulation under coupled spatial and temporal constraints. Prior work has largely focused on endowing robots with human-level manipulation skills, paying less attention to the structure of bimanual behaviour itself: many practical tasks are a coordinated composition of reusable unimanual skills and a small set of synchronous bimanual skills. This makes high-level spatio-temporal coordination, rather than skill acquisition alone, a key bottleneck for efficient bimanual execution. We propose BiPOP, a framework that couples Large Language Models (LLMs) with Temporal Partial-Order Planning for long-horizon bimanual manipulation. At its core is an explicit spatio-temporal model that partitions the workspace by arm reachability and captures inter-arm dependencies, arm assignment, synchronization requirements, and opportunities for safe concurrent execution. Building on this model, an LLM translates natural-language instructions into a formal PDDL specification, while a temporal planner enforces the constraints and schedules actions, yielding plans that are logically consistent at the symbolic level and efficient through parallel execution. On simulated long-horizon tasks of varying complexity, BiPOP outperforms open-loop planning with strong reasoning models and closed-loop ReAct-style planning in success rate, planning time, and plan efficiency, and the full pipeline runs end to end on the real bimanual robot NICOL. A failure analysis further shows that LLM-only planners mainly violate spatial and temporal coordination constraints, which motivates delegating these constraints to a symbolic planner. Code: https://github.com/Kchu/BiPOP

摘要（中文）：双臂机器人操作具有很高的通用性，但其核心挑战不仅在于让每只手臂执行灵巧的动作，还在于在空间和时间双重约束下协调双臂以完成长时程操作任务。以往的研究大多侧重于赋予机器人接近人类水平的操作技能，而对双臂行为本身的结构关注较少：许多实际任务是由可复用的单臂技能和少数同步双臂技能协同组合而成的。这使得高层级的时空协调——而非单纯技能习得——成为高效双臂执行的关键瓶颈。我们提出BiPOP框架，该框架将大语言模型（LLMs）与时间偏序规划相结合，用于长时程双臂操作。其核心是一个显式的时空模型，该模型根据手臂可达范围对工作空间进行划分，并捕获臂间依赖关系、手臂分配、同步需求以及安全并行执行的时机。在此模型基础上，LLM将自然语言指令转化为正式的PDDL规范，而时间规划器则负责执行约束并对动作进行调度，从而生成在符号层面逻辑一致、通过并行执行提升效率的计划。在复杂度不同的模拟长时程任务中，BiPOP在成功率、规划时间和计划效率方面均优于基于强推理模型的开放式规划以及闭环ReAct式规划，且完整流程可在真实双臂机器人NICOL上端到端运行。失败分析进一步表明，仅依赖LLM的规划器主要违反空间和时间协调约束，这支持了将这些约束交由符号规划器处理的设计思路。代码：https://github.com/Kchu/BiPOP

Authors: Kun Chu, Xufeng Zhao, Jan-Gerrit Habekost, Cornelius Weber, Stefan Wermter

AFTER: A World Model with Adaptive Fast--Slow Timescales for Error-Driven Retention WorldModel

world model dynamics adaptation fast-slow timescales error-driven retention robot control

简要说明：本文提出了AFTER-WM，一种具有自适应快慢时间尺度的世界模型，通过误差驱动的保留机制应对机器人动力学在交互中的突变，在仿真和真实机器人数据集上实现了更低的预测误差和更好的控制性能。

TLDR: This paper proposes AFTER-WM, a world model with adaptive fast-slow timescales for error-driven retention, to address the challenge of adapting to sudden, persistent changes in robot dynamics during interaction, achieving lower prediction errors and better control performance across simulated and real robot datasets.

Abstract: In robotics and embodied AI, a core challenge for world models is adapting to sudden, persistent, yet initially unknown changes in robot dynamics during interaction. For instance, when a robotic arm grasps an object with an unknown payload, the robot dynamics change suddenly. If the world model fails to adapt, its prediction errors accumulate over the open-loop rollout and ultimately mislead the robot's actions. Existing world models, however, struggle to simultaneously satisfy three critical requirements for dynamics adaptation: responsiveness, reacting promptly to sudden changes to curb prediction error accumulation; stability, distinguishing persistent changes from transient disturbances to prevent incorrect updates; and persistence, retaining the adapted dynamics without new observations so that later predictions do not revert to the old dynamics. Inspired by predictive coding in the human brain with multi-timescale adaptation, we propose AFTER-WM, a world model with Adaptive Fast-slow Timescales for Error-driven Retention, whose prediction errors drive a fast correction that fades and a slow correction that persists, while dynamically adjusting the combination weights of pre-trained experts without altering them, to overcome the trade-offs among responsiveness, stability and persistence. On five simulated robot datasets and real UAV data, AFTER-WM has a lower multi-step mean error than all ten compared models and the highest mean return in a joint-failure control task. In simulation, its multistep mean error is 16%-34% below the strongest compared model's and is also the lowest 1-4 steps after a change and under transient disturbances alone, and its step-40 error is the lowest as well, reflecting responsiveness, stability and persistence. All code (method, baselines, experiments) and datasets will be released online.

摘要（中文）：在机器人与具身人工智能领域，世界模型面临的一个核心挑战是如何在交互过程中适应机器人动力学中突发的、持久的但初始未知的变化。例如，当机械臂抓取一个具有未知有效载荷的物体时，机器人动力学会发生突然变化。如果世界模型未能及时适应，其预测误差会在开环展开过程中不断累积，最终误导机器人的动作。然而，现有的世界模型难以同时满足动力学自适应的三个关键需求：响应性——对突发变化迅速做出反应，以抑制预测误差累积；稳定性——区分持续性变化与瞬时扰动，避免错误更新；持久性——在没有新观测的情况下保持已适应的动力学，确保后续预测不会回退到旧有的动力学状态。受人类大脑中具有多时间尺度适应的预测编码机制启发，我们提出了AFTER-WM——一种具有自适应快慢时间尺度以实现误差驱动保持的世界模型。该模型通过预测误差驱动快速修正（逐渐消退）与慢速修正（持续保持），并动态调整预训练专家的组合权重而不改变专家本身，从而克服响应性、稳定性与持久性之间的权衡矛盾。在五个模拟机器人数据集及真实无人机数据上，AFTER-WM的多步平均误差均低于全部十个对比模型，并在联合故障控制任务中取得了最高的平均回报。在仿真中，其多步平均误差比最强对比模型低16%-34%，并且在变化后1-4步以及仅存在瞬时扰动的情况下均为最低误差，其第40步误差同样最低，这分别体现了响应性、稳定性与持久性。所有代码（包括方法、基线、实验）及数据集将全部在线公开。

Authors: Haoyi Zhang, Qi Zhang, Yunfan Ren, Yi Bin, Lei Zhu, Heng Tao Shen

ARTS: An Open-Source, Reproducible Three-Arm Platform for Autonomy Research in Minimally Invasive Surgery Manipulation

surgical robotics open-source platform ROS 2 minimally invasive surgery teleoperation

简要说明：ARTS 是一个开源、可复现的三臂机器人平台，用于微创手术自主性研究，由可购买部件构建，成本约 13.7 万美元，配备完整的 ROS 2 软件并展示了与自主性相关的能力。

TLDR: ARTS is an open-source, reproducible three-arm robotic platform for minimally invasive surgery research, built from purchasable parts for about $137,000, with full ROS 2 software and demonstrated autonomy-relevant capabilities.

Abstract: Research on surgical autonomy needs open platforms that any laboratory can build, yet the most widely shared platform depends on donated clinical hardware, and open alternatives on industrial arms each lack part of the surgical chain. We present the Autonomous Robotic Translational System (ARTS), an open-source three-arm platform for autonomy research in minimally invasive surgery, built entirely from purchasable parts for about USD 137,000. Two UR5e arms hold wristed da Vinci X/Xi instruments, a UR5 arm holds a stereo endoscope with two FLIR cameras, the surgeon console provides haptic handles, footswitches and a stereo viewer, and a hardware stop independent of the software lets a supervisor freeze all three arms in place. The ROS 2 software pins every dependency, installs from the same scripts on bare metal or in containers, and records stereo images with hardware-measured timing. On the real arms, ARTS commands each arm at its controller's full rate (e.g., 500 Hz on the UR5e), the two cameras expose within 12 microseconds of each other, hand motion reaches the arm in 58 ms, and the endoscope image reaches the monitor in 68 ms. The ISO 9283 pose repeatability is 0.14-0.25 mm, comparable to a da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK) Classic arm on the same protocol, and an optical tracker measured a mean remote-center-of-motion error of 0.34-0.37 mm. Three expert and three novice operators performed the Fundamentals of Laparoscopic Surgery (FLS) peg transfer through a laparoscopic trainer box, and one of the experts sutured on a suture pad. The hardware designs, firmware and software are available at https://github.com/MRE-Lab-UMD/arts.

摘要（中文）：研究手术自主性需要各实验室都能构建的开放平台，但目前应用最广泛的平台依赖于捐赠的临床硬件，而基于工业机械臂的开放替代方案各自缺少手术链中的某些环节。我们提出自主机器人转化系统（ARTS），这是一个开源的三臂平台，专为微创手术中的自主性研究设计，完全由可购买的部件构成，成本约为137，000美元。两条UR5e臂持握带腕部关节的达芬奇X/Xi器械，一条UR5臂持握配备两台FLIR相机的立体内窥镜，外科医生控制台提供触觉手柄、脚踏开关和立体 Viewer，且一个独立于软件的硬件急停装置可让监督者冻结全部三条臂。ROS 2软件固定了所有依赖项，可通过相同脚本在裸机或容器中安装，并以硬件测量的时间记录立体图像。在实际机械臂上，ARTS以控制器全速率（如UR5e上的500 Hz）命令每条臂，两台相机曝光时间相差12微秒以内，手部运动到达机械臂需58毫秒，内窥镜图像到达显示器需68毫秒。ISO 9283位姿重复性为0.14–0.25毫米，与同一协议下的达芬奇研究套件（dVRK）经典臂相当；光学跟踪器测量平均远程运动中心误差为0.34–0.37毫米。三名专家和三名新手操作者通过腹腔镜训练箱完成了腹腔镜外科基础（FLS）持针转移任务，其中一名专家在缝合垫上进行了缝合。硬件设计、固件和软件可在 https://github.com/MRE-Lab-UMD/arts 获取。

Authors: Jiawei Ge, Chunwoo Kim, Antony Goldenberg, Douglas McDonough, Justin Liao, Bo Ning, Sylvia Ladstaetter, Katya Van Anderlecht, Hao Ding, Laura Connolly, Ethan Kilmer, Francis Fan, Shouyue Hu, Tyler Salvador, Brendan Burkhart, Pit Henrich, Richard Cha, Tito Porras, Mathias Unberath, Kevin Cleary, Axel Krieger

PolyMorphWBC: Whole-Body Control from End-Effector Trajectories for Quadrupedal Mobile Manipulation across Arm Morphologies with Extended Reach Manipulation

quadrupedal mobile manipulation whole-body control end-effector trajectories morphology conditioning language-conditioned pick-and-place

简要说明：PolyMorphWBC 是一种分层控制器，以末端执行器轨迹为输入，为四足移动操作器在不同机械臂形态下生成协调的臂-基座运动，实现超出固定基座范围的抓取，并在真实机器人上完成了无需VLA生成基座命令的语言条件抓取任务。

TLDR: PolyMorphWBC is a hierarchical controller that takes end-effector trajectories as input and generates coordinated arm-base motions for quadrupedal mobile manipulators across various arm morphologies, achieving extended reach and enabling language-conditioned pick-and-place on a real robot without VLA-generated base commands.

Abstract: Quadrupedal mobile manipulators can extend their manipulation workspace by coordinating the mounted arm with the mobile base. At the task level, short-horizon end-effector (EE) trajectories provide an interface for specifying the desired manipulation motion without prescribing how it should be realized by the arm and base. However, executing such trajectories remains challenging because the controller must determine when and how the base should move, and this decision depends on the mounted-arm morphology. We therefore present PolyMorphWBC, a hierarchical controller that takes an EE trajectory as the sole task-level motion command and generates coordinated arm--base motions across four families of 6-DoF mounted arms, with extended-reach trajectories beyond the initial fixed-base reach. Within PolyMorphWBC, a trajectory-conditioned coordinator determines the base motion from previewed EE targets, while arm-specific Inverse Kinematics (IK) tracks the current target, and a frozen locomotion backend executes the resulting motion. Cross-arm reuse is enabled by a Unified Robot Description Format (URDF)-derived morphology conditioning, together with online residual-wrench feedback. We train PolyMorphWBC on procedurally generated arms and structured trajectories within and beyond fixed-base reach. In IsaacLab, it achieves 93.95% completion with 2.30cm position error and 4.81° orientation error on held-out trajectories and arm morphologies. In MuJoCo evaluation against UMI-on-Legs, PolyMorphWBC reduces EE position error by 69--72% and orientation error by 91--97% across four within- and extended-reach trajectories. On a physical Go2--ARX5 system, we demonstrate language-conditioned extended-reach pick-and-place using EE trajectories from pi_0 without vision-language-action (VLA)-generated base commands.

摘要（中文）：四足移动操作机器人通过将安装的机械臂与移动底盘协调配合，可扩展其操作工作空间。在任务层面，短时域末端执行器（EE）轨迹提供了一种接口，用于指定所需的操作运动，而无需规定机械臂和底盘应如何实现该运动。然而，执行此类轨迹仍具挑战性，因为控制器必须确定底盘何时以及如何移动，而这一决策取决于所安装机械臂的形态结构。为此，我们提出了PolyMorphWBC，一种分层控制器，它将末端执行器轨迹作为唯一的任务级运动指令，并在四类六自由度安装机械臂上生成协调的臂-底盘运动，支持超出初始固定基座可达范围的扩展到达轨迹。在PolyMorphWBC中，一个轨迹条件协调器根据预见的末端执行器目标确定底盘运动，而针对具体机械臂的逆运动学（IK）跟踪当前目标，冻结的移动后端则执行所得运动。跨机械臂复用通过基于统一机器人描述格式（URDF）的形态条件化以及在线残余力-力矩反馈得以实现。我们在程序化生成的机械臂以及固定基座可达范围内外的结构化轨迹上训练PolyMorphWBC。在IsaacLab中，该框架在保留轨迹和机械臂形态上实现了93.95%的完成率，位置误差为2.30厘米，姿态误差为4.81°。在与UMI-on-Legs的MuJoCo对比评估中，PolyMorphWBC在四条范围内及扩展到达轨迹上将末端执行器位置误差降低了69-72%，姿态误差降低了91-97%。在物理Go2-ARX5系统上，我们展示了利用pi_0生成的末端执行器轨迹实现基于语言条件的扩展到达抓取-放置操作，无需视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型生成底盘指令。

Authors: Heng Li, Yang Li, Yifan Duan, Ren Fang, Matao Duan, Wenhao Yu, Lu Zhang, Jianmin Ji, Yanyong Zhang

Elastra: A Simulation Framework for Elastic Bodies HumanoidEmbodied

simulation framework elastic bodies humanoid control residual policies reinforcement learning

简要说明：Elastra 是一个用于弹性体的仿真框架，模拟机器人与可变形表面的交互，并用于训练人形机器人在床垫和蹦床上站立的残差策略，显著提高了成功率。

TLDR: Elastra is a simulation framework for elastic bodies that models deformable surfaces for robot interaction, validated against real data and used to train residual policies for a humanoid robot to stand on mattresses and trampolines, significantly improving success rates.

Abstract: When robots interact with elastic surfaces such as mattresses and trampolines, changes in loading cause the surfaces to deform and rebound, altering subsequent contact locations and forces. We present Elastra, a simulation framework for modeling this interaction and supporting the training and evaluation of robot control policies. Elastra represents each surface using elements that move only vertically, with elastic connections and damping to model deformation and recovery. Contact forces drive surface motion, and the updated surface geometry is used to compute subsequent contact forces. We systematically validate our simulations against an independent implementation and a real mattress load curve. We further use Elastra to train the Unitree G1 humanoid to stand up on mattresses and trampolines. Using the pretrained HoST policy and ProtoMotions motion tracker as original controllers, we train residual policies through reinforcement learning to add corrections to their joint targets. Adding these residual policies increases the success rate with HoST from 44.1\% to 72.5\%, and from 55\% to 89\% on the trampoline. With ProtoMotions, the success rate increases from 19.0\% to 45.0\% for initial poses not encountered during training. The code and video are available on https://github.com/yichg/elastra.

摘要（中文）：当机器人（如人形机器人）与床垫、蹦床等弹性表面交互时，载荷变化会导致这些表面发生形变并回弹，从而改变后续接触位置和作用力。我们提出了Elastra，一个用于建模这种交互并支持机器人控制策略训练和评估的仿真框架。Elastra使用仅在垂直方向上移动的元素来表示每个表面，并通过弹性连接和阻尼来模拟形变与恢复。接触力驱动表面运动，更新后的表面几何形状用于计算后续的接触力。我们通过独立实现和真实床垫载荷曲线，系统地验证了仿真结果。此外，我们利用Elastra训练Unitree G1人形机器人在床垫和蹦床上实现站立动作。使用预训练的HoST策略和ProtoMotions运动跟踪器作为原始控制器，我们通过强化学习训练残差策略，为关节目标添加修正。添加这些残差策略后，HoST在床垫上的成功率从44.1%提高到72.5%，在蹦床上的成功率从55%提高到89%。对于训练中未遇到的初始姿态，ProtoMotions的成功率从19.0%提高到45.0%。代码和视频可在 https://github.com/yichg/elastra 获取。

Authors: Youran Sun, Chugang Yi, Xingyu Ren, Haizhao Yang

ILA: A Transferable Interface-Level Adapter for Compliant Humanoid Motion Tracking HumanoidEmbodied

humanoid motion tracking compliant control interface-level adapter physical human-robot interaction sim-to-real transfer

简要说明：本文提出了ILA，一种即插即用的接口级适配器，通过从观测历史预测参考修正，实现无需专用传感器的柔顺人形运动跟踪。它在仿真中训练，并在多种运动跟踪器上验证，展示了在保持标称性能的同时提高对人类引导的响应能力。

TLDR: This paper introduces ILA, a plug-and-play interface-level adapter that enables compliant humanoid motion tracking without dedicated sensors, by predicting reference corrections from observation history. It is trained in simulation and validated with multiple motion trackers, showing improved responsiveness to human guidance while preserving nominal performance.

Abstract: Humanoid motion tracking is fundamental to reproducing human motions on humanoid robots and serves as an important tool for teleoperation and motion data collection. However, directly tracking reference motions can be unsafe in constrained environments or during physical human--robot interaction, motivating the need for compliant motion tracking. We present ILA, an Interface-Level Adapter for compliant humanoid motion tracking without dedicated interaction sensors. ILA adapts motion references from the robot's observation history, allowing the robot to respond to physical guidance while preserving the capabilities of a pretrained motion tracker. As an interface-level module, ILA can be directly plugged into different pretrained motion trackers without retraining either the adapter or the tracking policies. ILA is trained entirely in simulation to predict reference corrections induced by physical interaction. We evaluate ILA with three humanoid motion trackers and achieve a 63.6--75.4% reduction in guidance-target error compared with their original policies. Matched simulation studies and hardware experiments further show that ILA improves responsiveness to human guidance while preserving nominal motion-tracking performance. These results demonstrate compliant guidance as a reusable, sensor-free extension to pretrained humanoid motion trackers.

摘要（中文）：人体运动跟踪是在仿人机器人上复现人体运动的基础，也是遥操作和运动数据采集的重要工具。然而，在受限环境中或进行物理人机交互时，直接跟踪参考运动可能存在安全隐患，因此需要具备柔顺运动跟踪能力。我们提出了ILA，一种无需专用交互传感器即可实现仿人机器人柔顺运动跟踪的接口级适配器。ILA根据机器人的观测历史调整运动参考，使机器人能够在保持预训练运动跟踪器能力的同时对物理引导作出响应。作为接口级模块，ILA可直接插入不同的预训练运动跟踪器，无需重新训练适配器或跟踪策略。ILA完全在仿真环境中训练，用于预测由物理交互引起的参考修正。我们使用三种仿人运动跟踪器对ILA进行了评估，与原始策略相比，引导目标误差降低了63.6%至75.4%。匹配的仿真研究和硬件实验进一步表明，ILA在保持标称运动跟踪性能的同时，提高了对人体引导的响应能力。这些结果证明了柔顺引导可以作为预训练仿人运动跟踪器的一种可复用、无传感器的扩展功能。

Authors: ZhuoChang Cai, Zihao Yan, Jinxuan Zhu, Yanjie Li, Hao Xiong

From a Single RGB Image to Robot Execution: Metric Scene Alignment and Contact-Guided Retargeting HumanoidEmbodied

single RGB image metric scene alignment contact-guided retargeting humanoid robot motion generation

简要说明：该论文提出了一种从单张RGB图像重建度量场景、生成人体交互动作并将其重定向到人形机器人的统一流程，通过两个精炼阶段保证几何一致性，并在Unitree G1上展示了更高的速度和成功率。

TLDR: This paper presents a pipeline that reconstructs metric scene geometry from a single RGB image, generates human interaction motion conditioned on the scene, and retargets it to a humanoid robot with two refinement stages to ensure geometric consistency. It demonstrates improved speed and success rates on the Unitree G1 robot.

Abstract: Extending humanoid interaction generation to new environments remains limited by the need for prebuilt 3D scene assets. Reconstructing scenes directly from single RGB images offers a way to overcome this limitation, but introduces a key challenge in maintaining geometric consistency throughout motion generation and transfer. Visually plausible human motions may be misaligned with the reconstructed scene, while retargeting can introduce additional support errors due to differences between human and robot embodiments. We present a unified pipeline that transforms a single RGB image into a humanoid motion reference. It reconstructs scene geometry from the input image, generates a human interaction conditioned on the reconstructed scene, and retargets the motion to a humanoid robot. To maintain geometric consistency throughout this process, we incorporate two complementary refinement stages before and after embodiment transfer. Before retargeting, Joint Metric Interaction Refinement (JMIR) refines human motion alignment with the registered metric scene while preserving the generated interaction structure. Following retargeting, Contact Guided Residual Retargeting (CGRR) corrects robot specific support errors to restore the intended support relationships. Together, these stages produce motion references that are consistent with the reconstructed scene and can be followed by multiple pretrained humanoid trackers without scene specific policy fine tuning. Compared with GRAIL, our method reduces refinement time from 480 s to 87 s, yielding a speedup of 5.5 times. The complete pipeline achieves a success rate of 89% in simulation and 70% across 50 physical trials on the Unitree G1, demonstrating its effectiveness in generating executable humanoid motion references from single RGB images.

摘要（中文）：将类人交互生成扩展到新环境，仍受限于对预构建三维场景资产的需求。直接从单张RGB图像重建场景为克服这一限制提供了途径，但也带来了在运动生成与迁移过程中保持几何一致性的关键挑战。视觉上合理的人体运动可能与重建场景错位，而重定向因人体与机器人本体之间的差异，可能引入额外的支撑误差。 我们提出一个统一流程，将单张RGB图像转化为类人机器人运动参考。该流程从输入图像重建场景几何，基于重建场景生成人体交互，并将运动重定向至类人机器人。为在整个过程中保持几何一致性，我们在本体迁移前后分别引入两个互补的优化阶段。在重定向之前，联合度量交互优化（JMIR）在保持生成交互结构的同时，优化人体运动与已配准度量场景的对齐。在重定向之后，接触引导残差重定向（CGRR）修正机器人特有的支撑误差，以恢复预期的支撑关系。这两个阶段共同生成与重建场景一致的运动参考，且无需场景特定的策略微调即可被多种预训练类人机器人跟踪器执行。与GRAIL相比，我们的方法将优化时间从480秒缩短至87秒，提速达5.5倍。完整流程在仿真中实现了89%的成功率，并在Unitree G1上的50次物理实验中达到70%的成功率，展示了其从单张RGB图像生成可执行类人机器人运动参考的有效性。

Authors: Zhenxuan Ding, Yu Huang, Xinmiao Wang, Chenghao Sun, Ziyang Dong, Wenhao Cui

Scaling VLA Serving Under Robotic Execution Constraints VLA

VLA serving inference infrastructure GPU efficiency robotic execution fleet serving

简要说明：XInfer 是一个已部署的生产级VLA服务系统，通过协调异构VLA计算与机器人执行约束，降低大规模机器人部署的推理基础设施成本，提高GPU利用率和有效机器人容量。

TLDR: XInfer is a production-deployed VLA serving system that coordinates heterogeneous VLA computation with robotic execution constraints, reducing inference infrastructure costs and improving GPU efficiency and effective robot capacity for large-scale robotic fleets.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose robotic manipulation. In our production setting, hundreds of VLA-powered robots are already operating in real-world environments, creating an immediate need for efficient fleet serving. We present XInfer, a production-deployed VLA serving system designed to reduce the inference infrastructure cost of large-scale robotic deployments. XInfer jointly coordinates heterogeneous VLA computation with the evolving response requirements of robotic execution. By exploiting computational parallelism while managing interference, XInfer improves GPU efficiency while protecting time-critical robotic feedback. We evaluate XInfer across three VLA models using production-derived workloads, achieving 1.26-3.75 times the effective robot capacity (ERC) of state-of-the-art systems under physical-execution constraints. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/X-Square-Robot/xinfer.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为通用机器人操作领域一种前景广阔的新范式。在我们的生产环境中，已有数百台由VLA驱动的机器人在真实环境中运行，因此亟需高效的机群服务能力。我们提出了XInfer——一个已部署于生产环境的VLA服务系统，旨在降低大规模机器人部署的推理基础设施成本。XInfer协同调度异构VLA计算资源，并适配机器人执行过程中不断变化的响应需求。通过利用计算并行性并管理干扰，XInfer在保障时间关键型机器人反馈的同时，提升了GPU利用效率。我们基于生产环境负载，在三种VLA模型上对XInfer进行了评估，在物理执行约束下，其有效机器人容量（ERC）达到现有最优系统的1.26至3.75倍。我们的实现已公开，可通过 https://github.com/X-Square-Robot/xinfer 访问。

Authors: Yue Zhang, Zicong Ye, Lufang Chen, Dance Yang, Mingyang Li, Zhenwei Duan, Michael Zhao, Ziye Deng, Starrick Liu, Ruizhi Chengze, YongHua Chen, SongAo Han, Yu Sun, Ran Yu, Xiaofan Li, Ruyi Gan, Hao Wang

The Posterior-Prior Epistemic Gap: When World Model Imagination Fails to Carry Task-Relevant Signals AutonomousDriving

world model epistemic gap active inference CARLA obstacle avoidance

简要说明：本文在CARLA驾驶模拟器中，针对用于主动推理规划的世界模型，识别出后验-先验认知差距：想象轨迹逐渐丢失障碍物信息，导致未标记的失败。同时证明，对同一世界模型的自由能组件进行任务条件加权，在提供特权坐标的情况下能实现车道保持和避障。

TLDR: This paper identifies a posterior-prior epistemic gap in a world model used for active-inference planning in CARLA, where imagined rollouts progressively lose obstacle information, causing unflagging failures in obstacle avoidance. It also shows that task-conditioned weighting of Effective Free Energy components over the same world model enables lane keeping and obstacle avoidance when privileged coordinates are used.

Abstract: Model-based planners that roll out imagined futures assume the transition model faithfully propagates task-relevant signals---a property rarely measured directly. In a single-seed case study of a Recurrent State Space Model world model with active-inference planning in the CARLA driving simulator, we identify a \textbf{posterior-prior gap}---posterior (observation-filtered) states retain obstacle information that imagined rollout states progressively lose: a supervised obstacle probe achieves AUC 0.85 on posterior states, but the same probe applied to imagined prior states shows monotonic decay (AUC 0.85$\rightarrow$0.71 over 15 steps; logit separation drops 57\%). Because the probe is identical, the decay isolates the transition model---not the representation---as the information bottleneck. Obstacle avoidance drops to 0\% without privileged runtime coordinates, and the planner's own ensemble-based epistemic term does not flag the loss---ensemble disagreement yields AUC 0.52 as an obstacle classifier (chance level), making the failure an unflagged imagination failure---an unknown unknown at planning time. As a secondary contribution, we show that \textbf{task-conditioned weighting of Effective Free Energy components} over the same world model yields lane keeping ($81.2 \pm 1.8$\% route completion) and obstacle avoidance (28/28 avoided, \emph{using privileged coordinates}) in the CARLA simulator, with runtime weight modulation enabling post-evasion centering.

摘要（中文）：基于模型规划器在推演未来情景时，假设转换模型能够忠实地传播与任务相关的信号——这一特性很少被直接度量。在CARLA驾驶模拟器中，以循环状态空间模型世界模型结合主动推断规划为对象的单一种子案例研究中，我们识别出一个\textbf{后验-先验差距}——后验（经观测滤波的）状态保留了障碍物信息，而想象推演状态则逐渐丧失这些信息：有监督的障碍物探针在后验状态上达到AUC 0.85，但同一探针应用于想象的先验状态时，表现出单调衰减（15步内AUC从0.85降至0.71；对数几率分离度下降57\%）。由于探针完全一致，这一衰减将转换模型——而非表征——确定为信息瓶颈。在没有特权运行时坐标的情况下，障碍物规避成功率降至0\%，且规划器自身的基于集成的不确定性项并未标记此损失——集成分歧作为障碍物分类器时AUC为0.52（随机水平），使得该失败成为一种未被标记的想象失败——即规划时的未知未知。作为次要贡献，我们表明，在同一世界模型上对\textbf{有效自由能组件的任务条件化加权}，在CARLA模拟器中实现了车道保持（$81.2 \pm 1.8$\%路线完成率）和障碍物规避（28/28次成功规避，\emph{使用特权坐标}），并且运行时的权重调制支持规避后的居中控制。

Authors: Jaerock Kwon, Elahe Delavari, Donghyun Kim, Haewoon Nam

Learning Low-Latency Action Verification for Frozen Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

action verification vision-language-action model hindsight manipulation latency

简要说明：本文提出HDH，一种利用冻结VLA自身部署的 hindsight 训练紧凑动作验证器的轻量级框架，以选择最佳动作候选，在LIBERO和真实世界操作任务中提高了成功率并降低了延迟。

TLDR: This paper introduces HDH, a lightweight framework that trains a compact action verifier using hindsight from a frozen VLA's own deployments to select the most promising action candidates, improving success rates on LIBERO and real-world manipulation tasks while reducing latency.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have made significant progress in general-purpose robotic manipulation. However, sampled action sequences can be ineffective, while evaluating alternatives with computationally expensive verifiers adds latency at each policy query. In this work, we propose HDH, a lightweight framework that uses hindsight from a frozen VLA's own deployments to improve action verification. The framework has three stages. First, we deploy the policy and collect its autonomous rollouts. We then train a compact action verifier to assign each action chunk a predicted task-success score. Finally, the frozen VLA generates action candidates, and the verifier selects the candidate with the highest score for execution. Across four LIBERO-10 tasks, HDH achieves an average success rate of 82.3\% and on three real-world manipulation tasks, HDH improves average success over the baseline policy by 22.6\%.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在通用机器人操作方面取得了显著进展。然而，采样的动作序列可能效率低下，而使用计算代价高昂的验证器来评估替代方案则会增加每次策略查询的延迟。在本工作中，我们提出HDH，一种轻量级框架，利用冻结的VLA自身部署中的后见之明来改进动作验证。该框架包含三个阶段。首先，我们部署策略并收集其自主回放数据。随后，我们训练一个紧凑的动作验证器，为每个动作块分配预测的任务成功分数。最后，冻结的VLA生成候选动作，验证器从中选择得分最高的候选动作进行执行。在四个LIBERO-10任务中，HDH实现了82.3\%的平均成功率；在三个真实世界操作任务中，HDH较基线策略将平均成功率提升了22.6\%。

Authors: Wen-Han Hsieh, Ken Jiankun Zheng, Chia-Chien Chen, David M. Chan, Trevor Darrell

Is Your Robot's Memory Just a Clock? Temporal Shortcuts in Memory-Augmented VLA Policies VLA

memory-augmented VLA temporal shortcut phantom progress event-indexed memory RoboMME

简要说明：本文识别并分析了记忆增强VLA策略中的“幻影进展”问题，即暂停或手腕微动等无效事件因时间采样和时间戳被误计为任务进展，并提出以事件索引的记忆作为修复方法。

TLDR: This paper identifies and analyzes 'phantom progress' in memory-augmented VLA policies, where null events such as pauses or wrist fidgets are mistakenly counted as task progress due to temporal sampling and time stamps in memory, and proposes event-indexed memory as a fix.

Abstract: Memory-augmented vision-language-action (VLA) policies are meant to remember what happened. Many of them, however, fill memory by time: they sample frames uniformly across the episode and stamp each frame with its time step. Because time passes even when nothing happens, such a memory may not tell waiting from working. We show that it does not. On the counting tasks of RoboMME, we make the robot briefly pause or fidget its wrist. Such a null event changes nothing the task depends on, yet a released memory VLA counts the interval as work done and stops early. We call this failure phantom progress. It cuts success from 47 to 16 of 50 on one task and from 44 to 10 on the other. When the same frames are withheld from memory, success returns, so the cause lies in memory rather than in the interruption itself. We trace the failure to a temporal shortcut: because demonstrations proceed at a steady pace, elapsed time predicts progress. Indeed, rescaling the time stamps alone makes the policy stop early when the clock runs fast and repeat when it runs slow. Surprisingly, removing the time encoding does not cure the failure, because the frames of a null event still occupy slots of the time-sampled memory. Across RoboMME's released designs, vulnerability follows how memory is indexed. Of the fixes the diagnosis suggests, training with injected pauses does not remove the failure and impairs counting, whereas indexing memory by events recovers half or more of the loss without retraining. A memory meant to remember what happened should count events rather than clock ticks.

摘要（中文）：记忆增强型视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略旨在记住所发生的事件。然而，其中许多策略通过时间填充记忆：它们在整个回合中均匀采样帧，并为每帧标记其时间步。由于即使没有发生任何事情时间也在流逝，这样的记忆可能无法区分“等待”与“工作”。我们证明事实确实如此。在RoboMME的计数任务中，我们让机器人短暂停顿或抖动其手腕。这种空事件不改变任务所依赖的任何内容，但已发布的记忆VLA却将这段时间间隔计为已完成的工作并提前停止。我们将这种失败称为“幻影进度”。在其中一个任务中，成功率从50次中的47次降至16次；在另一个任务中，从44次降至10次。当相同的帧从记忆中被剔除时，成功率得以恢复，因此原因在于记忆本身，而非中断这一行为。我们将此失败追溯至一种时间捷径：由于演示以稳定速度进行，经过的时间预测了进度。事实上，仅重新缩放时间戳，就会使策略在时钟加快时提前停止，在时钟减慢时重复执行。令人惊讶的是，移除时间编码并不能解决此失败，因为空事件的帧仍占据时间采样记忆的槽位。在RoboMME发布的设计中，脆弱性取决于记忆的索引方式。在诊断所建议的修复方案中，注入暂停的训练未能消除失败且损害了计数能力，而基于事件的记忆索引在不重新训练的情况下恢复了损失的一半或更多。旨在记住所发生事件的记忆应计数事件，而非时钟滴答。

Authors: Chubin Zhang, Bo An

One Policy for 100 Household Tasks: Our Solution for the 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge VLA

vision-language-action model BEHAVIOR challenge household tasks flow matching coding agent

简要说明：本文提出了一个用于2026年BEHAVIOR挑战赛中100个任务的单一视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型，最终排名第9。通过延长训练、方差缩减流匹配以及为14个任务引入编码代理，提升了性能。

TLDR: The paper presents a single vision-language-action (VLA) model for all 100 tasks in the 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge, achieving 9th place. It improves prior work via longer training, variance-reduced flow matching, and augmenting the learned policy with a coding agent for 14 tasks.

Abstract: We describe our solution for the 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge: 100 long-horizon household tasks in the OmniGibson simulator. We placed 9th on the final leaderboard, the only independent team in the top 10. The core of the solution is a single vision-language-action (VLA) model, one checkpoint for all 100 tasks, built on our 1st-place 2025 solution, which is based on $π_{0.5}$. On the 50 tasks shared with 2025, its Q rises from 0.260 to 0.371; across all 100 tasks it scores 0.392. Our main conclusion from 2025 was that the model was undertrained, so most of the 2026 work went into training the model for longer, optimizing some training parameters, making each training step slightly faster and reducing the gradient noise: a migration from 50 to 100 tasks (semantic stages built from the demonstrations' skill annotations, task and stage embeddings of new tasks warm-started from similar old ones, and a 21-dimensional action space matching the teleoperation controls); variance-reduced multi-sample flow matching with a simple noise-vs-compute model that picks the number of action-expert samples per observation without ablations; and a 200k-step training run, about one pass over the 211M frames of the demonstrations. A cloud evaluation infrastructure keeps a shared record with provenance, episode diagnostics and restorable simulator states, and runs six simulators on one GPU together faster than real time. On top of the learned policy, 14 tasks are routed to a GPT-6 Astra coding agent that controls the robot through observation and motion tools, starting every episode from a frozen copy of its own practice session on training instances. Across these 14 tasks, Astra's mean Q is 0.639, against 0.108 for the learned policy. The public submission included only part of the Astra results and scored 0.446 Q with 27.3% full-task success.

摘要（中文）：我们介绍我们针对2026年BEHAVIOR挑战赛的解决方案：OmniGibson模拟器中的100项长时程家务任务。我们在最终排行榜上位列第九，是前十名中唯一的独立团队。解决方案的核心是一个统一的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，一个适用于全部100项任务的检查点，基于我们2025年获得第一名的解决方案（该方案基于$π_{0.5}$）。在2025年共享的50项任务中，其Q值从0.260提升至0.371；在全部100项任务中得分为0.392。我们从2025年得出的主要结论是模型训练不足，因此2026年的大部分工作集中在延长训练时间、优化部分训练参数、略微加快每一步训练速度并降低梯度噪声上：从50项任务扩展到100项任务（利用演示中的技能标注构建语义阶段，新任务的任务和阶段嵌入从相似旧任务中热启动，以及匹配遥操作控制的21维动作空间）；采用方差缩减的多样本流匹配，配以简单的噪声与计算量模型，无需消融实验即可为每个观测值选择动作专家样本数；以及一次200,000步的训练运行，相当于对演示数据中2.11亿帧进行一次遍历。云端评估基础设施维护着带有来源记录、情节诊断和可恢复模拟器状态的共享记录，并在一张GPU上同时运行六个模拟器，速度超过实时。在学得策略之上，14项任务被路由给GPT-6 Astra编码代理，该代理通过观测和运动工具控制机器人，每集都从其在训练实例上自身练习会话的冻结副本开始。在这14项任务中，Astra的平均Q值为0.639，而学得策略仅为0.108。公开提交结果仅包含部分Astra结果，Q值为0.446，完整任务成功率为27.3%。

Authors: Ilia Larchenko, Gleb Zarin, Atindra Nair, Keerti Manney, Vitaly Kleban, Mirko Kiefer, Anjana Yodaiken

CARE-Drive: Coupled Alternating Refinement for Ego-trajectories AutonomousDriving

Vision-Language-Action (VLA) Ego-trajectory refinement Position-conditioned heading generation Reinforcement fine-tuning NAVSIM

简要说明：CARE-Drive 将自车轨迹细化分解为位置残差修正和位置条件下的航向生成，在 NAVSIM 上达到 88.8 PDMS。

TLDR: CARE-Drive decomposes ego-trajectory refinement into position residual correction and position-conditioned heading generation for autonomous driving, achieving 88.8 PDMS on NAVSIM.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models bring multimodal understanding and world knowledge to end-to-end autonomous driving. To further improve the quality of predicted trajectories, existing studies introduce candidate refinement, residual denoising, and token correction. However, these methods typically focus on unified refinement of the entire trajectory, paying limited attention to the distinct physical quantities and their interactions. We further investigate physical specialization and coordination in trajectory refinement, centering on position and heading for simpler and more intuitive correction modeling. To this end, we propose CARE-Drive (Coupled Alternating Refinement for Ego-trajectories), which decomposes trajectory refinement into waypoint residual correction and position-conditioned heading generation. Through imitation learning and a future-token auxiliary task, the backbone provides predictive representations and a base trajectory. The position expert predicts bounded metric waypoint residuals, while the heading expert reconstructs vehicle orientation from adjacent angular increments conditioned on the corrected path. With the backbone frozen, the two experts are optimized alternately through supervised initialization and reinforcement fine-tuning. This design simplifies refinement through clear physical specialization while preserving conditional coupling during prediction and optimization. On NAVSIM v1, CARE-Drive achieves 88.8 PDMS, improving by 2.4 points over the unrefined base trajectories generated by the same backbone. Ablation studies further support the effectiveness of specialized experts and staged training.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将多模态理解与世界知识引入端到端自动驾驶。为进一步提升预测轨迹的质量，现有研究引入了候选精细化、残差去噪和令牌修正等方法。然而，这些方法通常聚焦于整条轨迹的统一精细化，对不同的物理量及其交互关注有限。我们进一步探索轨迹精细化中的物理量专门化与协同，围绕位置和航向进行更简单、更直观的修正建模。为此，我们提出CARE-Drive（Coupled Alternating Refinement for Ego-trajectories，自车轨迹耦合交替精细化），将轨迹精细化分解为路点残差修正和位置条件航向生成。通过模仿学习和未来令牌辅助任务，主干网络提供预测性表征和基础轨迹。位置专家预测有界的度量路点残差，而航向专家基于修正后的路径，从相邻角度增量中重建车辆朝向。在主干网络冻结的情况下，两个专家通过监督初始化和强化学习微调交替优化。该设计通过明确的物理量专门化简化了精细化过程，同时在预测和优化过程中保持了条件耦合。在NAVSIM v1上，CARE-Drive达到88.8的PDMS，相较同一主干网络生成的未精细化基础轨迹提升了2.4个百分点。消融研究进一步验证了专门化专家和分阶段训练的有效性。

Authors: Xiao Ma, Yijun Chen, Zhiquan Hu, Jicheng Zhao, Yuming Li, Chuang Dai

Towards Robust Vision-Language Reasoning: A Multi-Stage Optimization Pipeline with Masked Diffusion Model AutonomousDriving

Masked Diffusion Vision-Language Model Autonomous Driving Multi-stage Optimization Closed-loop Planning

简要说明：本文提出了用于自动驾驶视觉语言模型的多阶段优化流水线，利用掩码扩散改进规划性能。MD-Drive模型在闭环和开环驾驶基准上比未优化基线提升了29.7%。

TLDR: This paper introduces a multi-stage optimization pipeline for vision-language models in autonomous driving, using masked diffusion to improve planning performance. The MD-Drive model improves closed-loop and open-loop driving benchmarks by 29.7% over unoptimized baselines.

Abstract: Discrete diffusion generation is emerging as a competitive alternative to autoregressive generation by denoising the entire token sequence through iterative refinement. Its global planning and progressive correction capabilities are particularly well suited to autonomous driving. However, transferring this generation paradigm from general-purpose settings to driving introduces substantial domain gaps in both training and inference. To unlock its potential, we propose a multi-stage optimization pipeline for standard vision-language model architectures, without auxiliary action experts or specialized mixture-of-experts Transformer, spanning post-training and inference. During supervised fine-tuning, we optimize the representation of planning inputs to suppress hallucinations in task responses. During reinforcement learning, we introduce metric-guided diversity filtering to identify stronger learning starting points and improve policy exploration. At inference time, we propose Dynamic Autonomous Driving Decoding (DAD), which adaptively adjusts decoding modes according to scene complexity. Based on this pipeline, we develop Masked Diffusion Drive (MD-Drive), improving its performance by 29.7\% over the unoptimized model. Experiments on the NAVSIM closed loop benchmark and the nuScenes and DriveCoT open loop datasets show that MD-Drive outperforms autoregressive VLM baselines with the same architecture, while achieving a more favorable balance between performance and computational cost than systems with different architectures through discrete diffusion training and inference.

摘要（中文）：离散扩散生成通过迭代细化对整个token序列进行去噪，正逐渐成为自回归生成的有力替代方案。其全局规划和渐进修正能力尤其适用于自动驾驶场景。然而，将该生成范式从通用场景迁移至驾驶领域，在训练和推理两个阶段均引入了显著的领域差距。为释放其潜力，我们提出了一种面向标准视觉-语言模型架构的多阶段优化流程，无需辅助动作专家或专门的混合专家Transformer，涵盖后训练与推理两个环节。在监督微调阶段，我们对规划输入的表示进行优化，以抑制任务响应中的幻觉现象。在强化学习阶段，我们引入基于指标的多样性过滤，以识别更强的学习起点并提升策略探索效率。在推理阶段，我们提出动态自动驾驶解码（DAD），根据场景复杂度自适应调整解码模式。基于上述流程，我们开发了Masked Diffusion Drive（MD-Drive），相较于未优化模型，其性能提升了29.7%。在NAVSIM闭环基准以及nuScenes和DriveCoT开环数据集上的实验表明，MD-Drive在相同架构下优于自回归视觉语言模型基线，同时通过离散扩散训练与推理，在不同架构系统间实现了性能与计算成本之间更优的平衡。

Authors: Shunming Liu, Pei Huang, Yajing Sun, Huaxiao Liu

CFGComposer: Compositional Audio-Text-to-Motion Generation via Copula Score Correction HumanoidEmbodied

audio-text-to-motion diffusion models copula score correction humanoid robot gesture generation

简要说明：本文提出CFGComposer，一种基于扩散模型的方法，通过copula分数校正组合独立训练的模型，从音频和文本生成全身手势，达到最先进效果并在人形机器人上部署。

TLDR: This paper proposes CFGComposer, a diffusion-based method for generating whole-body gestures from audio and text by composing independently-trained models with a copula score correction, achieving state-of-the-art results and deployment on a humanoid robot.

Abstract: Generating whole-body gestures that are simultaneously rhythmically synchronized with speech audio and semantically aligned with text descriptions is a fundamental challenge in embodied AI and social robotics. We tackle this Audio-Text-to-Motion (AT2M) problem by composing two independently-trained diffusion models at inference time and refine bias in joint inference by modeling the copula score $s_I$. A rigorous theoretical analysis reveals that naive epsilon blending corresponds to a Product-of-Experts formulation that omits the copula score $s_I$: the cross-modal interaction between audio and text that neither marginal model can capture. We propose CFGComposer: a jointly-trained AT2M diffusion model that estimates $s_I$ via a CFG analogy and injects it as an $ε$-space correction. Experiments on BEAT demonstrate best-in-class semantic fidelity (SRGR $0.9916$, FID $27.18$) with GT-level beat alignment (BA $0.1826$ vs. GT $0.1743$), and 76-83% win rate in blind pairwise human evaluation against all prior methods. Physical deployment on a Unitree G1 humanoid confirms direct sim-to-real transfer.

摘要（中文）：生成与语音音频节奏同步且与文本描述语义对齐的全身手势，是具身人工智能和社交机器人领域的一项基础性挑战。我们通过组合两个独立训练的扩散模型在推理阶段解决这一音频-文本到动作（AT2M）问题，并通过建模联结函数得分 $s_I$ 来修正联合推理中的偏差。严格的理论分析表明，朴素的epsilon混合对应一种专家乘积（Product-of-Experts）公式，该公式忽略了联结函数得分 $s_I$，即音频与文本之间的跨模态交互，而这一交互是任何单个边际模型都无法捕获的。我们提出CFGComposer：一种联合训练的AT2M扩散模型，通过CFG类比估计$s_I$，并将其作为$ε$空间修正注入。在BEAT数据集上的实验表明，该方法在语义保真度方面达到同类最佳水平（SRGR $0.9916$，FID $27.18$），节拍对齐达到GT级水平（BA $0.1826$ vs. GT $0.1743$），并且在针对所有先前方法的盲测成对人工评估中取得了76-83%的胜率。在Unitree G1人形机器人上的物理部署证实了直接的仿真到现实迁移能力。

Authors: Pengyang Shi, Jinlu Zhang, Chunze Lin, Yizhou Wang, Li Yi

Driving World Models Move the Camera, Not the Scene WorldModel

driving world models plan-conditioned forecasting scene response ReTime-Compose autonomous driving

简要说明：本文诊断了规划条件驾驶世界模型未能根据规划轨迹移动场景，并提出了ReTime-Compose，一种无需训练的方法，将上下文帧传输到规划的相机位姿，在多个驾驶数据集和生成器上改善了场景响应。

TLDR: This paper diagnoses that plan-conditioned driving world models fail to move the scene according to the planned trajectory, and proposes ReTime-Compose, a training-free method that transports context frames to planned camera poses, improving scene response across multiple driving datasets and generators.

Abstract: Plan-conditioned driving world models are used to compare candidate plans, so their forecast should change with the plan as the real scene would, yet widely used control metrics check only whether the camera follows the command. Recorded drives already contain real outcomes of plans that were never driven: retiming a log gives pose-matched images and LiDAR for other speeds, and a stereo rig records a laterally shifted view. Against these references, released world models move their camera but barely move the scene: their scene response, the share of the real change in distance that the forecast reproduces, reaches at most about a third of real video's, and the trajectory score cannot tell an executed speed command from an ignored one. Interventions inside the generator trace the failure to the plan's channel. The forecast geometry follows the context frames; once they carry the planned geometry, plan tokens add little. ReTime-Compose therefore delivers the plan as geometry, without training. It transports the frames of one logged-speed rollout to the planned cameras, and the frozen model completes only what no frame covers. Frozen generators then follow a 0.54 m lateral shift nearly as the real scene does on KITTI, nuScenes and Argoverse 2, and respond more than re-sampling to slow-down plans in three generators and to speed-up plans in two.

摘要（中文）：规划条件下的驾驶世界模型用于比较候选规划方案，因此其预测应像真实场景一样随规划变化，但广泛使用的控制指标仅检查摄像头是否遵循指令。记录的行车数据已包含从未实际执行的规划的真实结果：对日志重新定时可为其他速度提供姿态匹配的图像和激光雷达，而立体视觉装置则记录横向偏移的视图。相较于这些参考，已发布的世界模型移动了其摄像头，但几乎未移动场景：其场景响应——即预测所再现的真实距离变化比例——最多仅达到真实视频的三分之一左右，且轨迹得分无法区分已执行的速度指令与被忽略的指令。生成器内部的干预措施将失败归因于规划通道。预测几何结构跟随上下文帧；一旦这些帧承载了规划的几何结构，规划令牌便几乎不再增添信息。因此，ReTime-Compose无需训练即可将规划以几何形式传递。它将某一记录速度展开的帧迁移至规划摄像头视角，而冻结的模型仅补全未被任何帧覆盖的部分。由此，在KITTI、nuScenes和Argoverse 2数据集上，冻结的生成器能够近乎真实地响应0.54米的横向偏移，并且在三个生成器中比重新采样更敏感地响应减速规划，在两个生成器中更敏感地响应加速规划。

Authors: Yuqiao Feng, Xiaoyu Ao

BirdDreams: Joint Perspective and BEV Video Generation for a Plausible, Reactive Driving World Model AutonomousDriving

world model BEV generation driving simulation autoregressive video diffusion ego-trajectory control

简要说明：BirdDreams 提出了一种驾驶世界模型，联合生成透视视频和BEV视频，利用预测的BEV作为自我轨迹控制的几何界面，同时提高运动合理性和反应性。

TLDR: BirdDreams introduces a driving world model that jointly generates perspective video and BEV video, using the predicted BEV as a geometric interface for ego-trajectory control while improving motion plausibility and reactivity.

Abstract: Driving world models aim to simulate how a scene unfolds under different ego actions. This requires plausible motion of surrounding vehicles as well as precise ego-trajectory control. Learning vehicle motion from perspective video alone is challenging because motion is entangled with appearance and vehicles can be occluded. Prior work therefore conditions video generation on layouts that specify vehicle motion, providing control over surrounding vehicles but requiring their future trajectories as inputs. We introduce BirdDreams, an autoregressive driving world model that jointly generates perspective video and a schematic bird's-eye-view (BEV) video, making scene layout part of the predicted future. The BEV, rendered from scene annotations for training, depicts roads and vehicles as simple shapes at a fixed metric scale, providing a top-down view of their positions and motion with reduced occlusion between vehicles. Perspective video, by contrast, retains scene details that the BEV omits, such as traffic signals and object appearance. Joint attention between two video diffusion transformers, one per stream, lets each stream inform the other during generation. The predicted BEV also provides a geometric interface for ego control: we translate and rotate its latest frame along an input ego trajectory and use the resulting frames as a soft condition that shows how the scene would appear to move if only the ego vehicle moved. At inference, BirdDreams generates both videos from a single camera image without requiring an HD map or vehicle-state inputs. On PhysicalAI-AV and nuScenes, BirdDreams follows input ego trajectories more faithfully than prior driving world models and generates more plausible ego motion without ego-action conditioning. Human evaluation shows that BirdDreams outperforms a perspective-only baseline in generating realistic surrounding-vehicle behavior.

摘要（中文）：驾驶世界模型旨在模拟场景在不同自我动作下如何展开。这要求周围车辆的运动具有合理性，同时实现精确的自车轨迹控制。仅从透视视频中学习车辆运动具有挑战性，因为运动与外观相互纠缠，且车辆可能被遮挡。因此，先前的工作将视频生成条件化为指定车辆运动的布局，从而能够控制周围车辆，但需要其未来轨迹作为输入。我们提出了BirdDreams，一种自回归驾驶世界模型，它联合生成透视视频和示意性的鸟瞰图（BEV）视频，使场景布局成为预测未来的一部分。BEV从用于训练的场景标注中渲染，以固定的度量尺度将道路和车辆描绘为简单形状，提供其位置和运动的俯视图，并减少了车辆之间的遮挡。相比之下，透视视频保留了BEV所省略的场景细节，如交通信号灯和物体外观。两个视频扩散Transformer（每个流一个）之间的联合注意力机制，使得每个流在生成过程中能够相互提供信息。预测的BEV还提供了用于自车控制的几何接口：我们沿输入的自车轨迹平移和旋转其最新帧，并将生成的帧作为软条件，展示如果只有自车移动时场景将如何运动。在推理时，BirdDreams仅从单个摄像头图像生成两种视频，无需高清地图或车辆状态输入。在PhysicalAI-AV和nuScenes数据集上，BirdDreams比先前的驾驶世界模型更忠实地遵循输入的自车轨迹，并在没有自车动作条件的情况下生成更合理的自车运动。人工评估表明，BirdDreams在生成逼真的周围车辆行为方面优于仅透视的基线模型。

Authors: Junyoung Seo, Jaewoo Seo, Seungryong Kim, Laura Leal-Taixé, Xiuming Zhang, Seung Wook Kim

Prediction-Error-Tightened MPC for Socially Compliant Crowd Navigation Other

Model Predictive Control Crowd Navigation Koopman-based prediction Prediction-error tightening Socially compliant

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于人群导航的模型预测控制（MPC）框架，该框架集成了行人检测、基于Koopman的运动预测和在线预测误差估计，以提高社交合规性和安全性。

TLDR: This paper presents a Model Predictive Control (MPC) framework for crowd navigation that integrates pedestrian detection, Koopman-based motion prediction, and online prediction-error estimation to improve social compliance and safety.

Abstract: Autonomous navigation of mobile robots in crowded environments, while preserving pedestrians' psychological comfort, requires distinguishing pedestrians from other obstacles, predicting their future motion, and accounting for uncertainty in the predicted trajectories of both pedestrians and the robot. This work extends a previous MPC framework by integrating obstacle and pedestrian detection, Koopman-based motion prediction, and online prediction-error estimation directly within the collision-avoidance mechanism. To reduce collision-avoidance complexity in crowded scenarios, nearby obstacles are aggregated, thereby reducing the number of collision-avoidance constraints. Simulation studies evaluate the prediction-error margins and the computational benefits of semantics-aware aggregation. In a paired 300-seed closed-loop comparison with a moving generic obstacle, Markov residual tightening reduces the fraction of runs with physical contact from $10.0\%$ to $1.33\%$, at a mean travel-time cost of $0.68$ s. In a separate crowd-navigation semantic ablation, the offline robot-footprint/personal-space overlap occupies $2.11\%$ of observed time with pedestrian-aware handling versus $22.84\%$ with generic-obstacle handling.

摘要（中文）：在拥挤环境中移动机器人的自主导航，同时保障行人的心理舒适度，需要将行人与其他障碍物区分开来，预测其未来运动，并考虑行人与机器人预测轨迹中的不确定性。本研究在先前模型预测控制（MPC）框架的基础上进行了扩展，将障碍物与行人检测、基于库普曼（Koopman）的运动预测以及在线预测误差估计直接整合进避碰机制中。为降低拥挤场景下的避碰计算复杂度，邻近障碍物被聚合处理，从而减少了避碰约束的数量。仿真研究评估了预测误差裕度以及语义感知聚合带来的计算优势。在与移动通用障碍物进行的配对300次随机种子闭环对比中，马尔可夫残差收紧方法将发生物理接触的试验比例从\(10.0\%\)降至\(1.33\%\)，平均行程时间成本仅为\(0.68\)秒。在另一项针对人群导航的语义消融实验中，采用行人感知处理时，机器人足迹与个人空间的离线重叠时间占比为\(2.11\%\)，而采用通用障碍物处理时该比例为\(22.84\%\)。

Authors: Alessandro Febbraro, Federico Rollo, Marcello Farina, Luca Bascetta, Navvab Kashiri

What World Model Does Active Object Search Need? A Study under Imperfect Detection RLRobot

Active Object Search Bayesian Inference Imperfect Detection World Model Embodied Agents

简要说明：本文提出了BAMOS，一个贝叶斯主动物体搜索框架，用于研究在模拟家庭环境中，目标信念、占用信念和检测器误差如何影响不完美检测下的搜索决策。

TLDR: This paper introduces BAMOS, a Bayesian active object search framework, to study how target belief, occupancy belief, and detector errors influence search decisions under imperfect detection in simulated household environments.

Abstract: In active object search, a robot must decide where to look and when to stop. Imperfect detection complicates both decisions: a non-detection may indicate occlusion, an out-of-view target, or a false negative, while a detection may be a false positive. This raises the question of which representations a world model needs to support reliable search under imperfect detection. We introduce Bayesian Active Miss-aware Object Search (BAMOS) to investigate how target belief, occupancy belief, and detector errors affect search decisions. Through comprehensive ablations in Isaac Sim and HSSD houses, we examine the roles of these representations and their update mechanisms across different detector configurations. Notably, target belief and its update mechanisms are critical to search performance, with their contribution generally increasing as detection errors become more prevalent. These findings highlight the importance of maintaining and updating target beliefs to support reliable active search under uncertain detector observations, providing insights into the design of world models for embodied agents. Code is available in https://github.com/gokyeongryeol/BAMOS.

摘要（中文）：在主动目标搜索中，机器人必须决定在哪里寻找以及何时停止。不完美的检测使得这两个决策变得复杂：未检测到目标可能意味着遮挡、目标在视野之外或假阴性，而检测到目标也可能是假阳性。这引发了一个问题：在世界模型中需要哪些表示来支持在不完美检测条件下进行可靠搜索。我们引入了贝叶斯主动漏检感知目标搜索（BAMOS），以研究目标信念、占用信念和检测器误差如何影响搜索决策。通过在Isaac Sim和HSSD房屋环境中进行的全面消融实验，我们考察了这些表示及其更新机制在不同检测器配置下的作用。值得注意的是，目标信念及其更新机制对搜索性能至关重要，且随着检测误差的普遍增加，它们的贡献通常也随之增大。这些发现强调了在不确定检测器观测条件下，维护和更新目标信念以支持可靠的主动搜索的重要性，为具身智能体的世界模型设计提供了见解。代码可在 https://github.com/gokyeongryeol/BAMOS 获取。

Authors: Kyeongryeol Go

Embedded Sim-to-Real Visual Servoing: Learned Reaching and Force-Guided Placement Manipulation

sim-to-real visual servoing PPO force-guided placement embedded perception

简要说明：本文介绍了在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上控制Franka机器人的嵌入式仿真到现实视觉伺服系统，结合学习PPO策略进行到达和力引导放置，在真实机器人上实现70-74%的成功率，且感知延迟低。

TLDR: This paper presents an embedded sim-to-real visual servoing system on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin controlling a Franka robot, combining learned PPO policies for reaching with force-guided placement, achieving 70-74% real-robot success with low perception latency.

Abstract: Embedded perception-to-control systems must combine visual targeting with reliable contact handling under tight computational constraints. We present a shared architecture on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin controlling a Franka Research 3 through Cartesian impedance control. RealSense D435i observations, YOLO11-seg segmentation, depth back-projection, and hand--eye calibration provide metric robot-frame targets. We compare two strategies: compact proximal policy optimization (PPO) policies transferred from simulation for object- and hole-region reaching, and force-guided Cartesian placement using approximately 2 N normal contact and spiral search. The PPO policies achieved 87.2% and 83.1% success over 1000 simulation episodes each. Across 50 real-robot trials per strategy, the learned hybrid and force-guided analytical pipelines achieved 70.0% and 74.0% completion, respectively. Mean perception latency with TensorRT was 34.55 ms. These results support an embedded architecture combining learned free-space reaching with explicit contact correction.

摘要（中文）：嵌入式感知-控制系统必须在严格的计算约束下，将视觉目标定位与可靠的接触处理相结合。我们提出了一种基于NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin的共享架构，通过笛卡尔阻抗控制实现对Franka Research 3机器人的控制。RealSense D435i观测数据、YOLO11-seg分割、深度反投影以及手眼标定共同提供了机器人坐标系下的公制目标。我们比较了两种策略：从仿真迁移的紧凑型近端策略优化（PPO）策略，用于物体区域和孔洞区域的到达操作；以及基于力引导的笛卡尔放置策略，采用约2 N的法向接触力和螺旋搜索。PPO策略在每次1000次仿真试验中分别实现了87.2%和83.1%的成功率。在每种策略各50次真实机器人试验中，学习型混合管道和力引导解析管道分别实现了70.0%和74.0%的完成率。使用TensorRT的平均感知延迟为34.55 ms。这些结果支持了一种将学习型自由空间到达操作与显式接触校正相结合的嵌入式架构。

Authors: Dezhi Sun, Duy Khang Banh, Kenan Niu

Single-View RGB-D Force--Deformation Estimation for Robotic Manipulation of Elasto-Plastic Materials Manipulation

force-deformation estimation RGB-D point cloud elasto-plastic manipulation intrinsic force sensing deformation localization

简要说明：该论文提出了一种利用单目眼在手RGB-D相机和固有力估计来估计弹塑性材料力-变形关系的方法，并在真实机器人上通过学习的MLP模型展示了累积变形定位。

TLDR: This paper presents a method for estimating force-deformation relationships in elasto-plastic materials using a single eye-in-hand RGB-D camera and intrinsic force estimates on a real robot, demonstrating cumulative deformation localization with a learned MLP model.

Abstract: Persistent deformation complicates elasto-plastic manipulation by coupling physical interaction with spatially distributed shape changes. We investigate the force--deformation relationship using a standard robot, a single eye-in-hand RGB-D camera, and intrinsic force estimates. A 7-DoF Franka Emika FR3 performs normal indentations while an Intel RealSense L515 captures pre- and post-contact surfaces. Point-cloud processing localizes deformation and estimates displaced volume. Force--volume characterization includes 27 measurements over nine force levels. A compact multilayer perceptron (MLP), trained on 52 force--volume pairs at four levels, achieves a held-out RMSE of 1.857 N and $R^2=0.440$. A separate comparison shows lower error for a quadratic model at 16 N and for the MLP at 19 and 23.5 N. An eight-step experiment at 4 N per interaction demonstrates cumulative deformation localization from the second indentation onward. These results establish a practical measurement basis for deformation-aware manipulation using intrinsic force estimates and single-view geometry.

摘要（中文）：持续变形通过在物理交互与空间分布形状变化之间建立耦合，使弹塑性操控变得复杂。我们利用标准机器人、单只眼在手RGB-D相机以及内在力估计，研究力与变形之间的关系。一台7自由度Franka Emika FR3执行法向压痕操作，同时Intel RealSense L515捕捉接触前和接触后的表面。点云处理用于定位变形区域并估算位移体积。力-体积特性表征包含9个力级别下的27次测量。一个紧凑的多层感知器（MLP）在4个级别的52个力-体积对上进行训练，其留出集上的均方根误差（RMSE）为1.857 N，决定系数（$R^2$）为0.440。另一项对比显示，二次模型在16 N处误差较低，而MLP在19 N和23.5 N处误差较低。一项每次交互施加4 N的八步实验表明，从第二次压痕起即可实现累积变形的定位。这些结果为利用内在力估计和单视角几何进行变形感知操控奠定了实用的测量基础。

Authors: Dezhi Sun, Marijn van Hilten, Kenan Niu

Generalized Inverse Kinematics via Conditional Flow Manipulation

inverse kinematics generative modeling conditional flow bimanual manipulation scene awareness

简要说明：GenGenIK 是一种基于条件流的生成式逆运动学模型，可输出机器人配置分布，支持移动底座、多末端执行器、场景感知和行为偏好，在双臂任务中实现了更高的求解率和更快的运行速度。

TLDR: GenGenIK is a generative flow-based inverse kinematics model that outputs distributions over robot configurations, supporting mobile bases, multiple end-effectors, scene awareness, and behavioral preferences, achieving higher solve rates and faster runtime in bimanual tasks.

Abstract: Inverse kinematics (IK) is a foundational primitive in robotics, mapping the task-space objectives expressed by higher-level planners to robot configurations that realize them. Traditional IK methods generally treat each query as an isolated pose-to-configuration problem, but planners often need a distribution over valid realizations that accounts for future reachability and preferences such as collision avoidance and stability. We introduce GenGenIK, a generative modeling approach that supports mobile bases, multiple end-effectors and targets, scene awareness, and preferences over robot behavior within a common interface. Experiments show that GenGenIK outperforms existing methods in both solve rate and runtime across tasks such as bimanual lift and flip-up, while allowing flexible control over the sampled distribution and remaining effective under partial scene observations. Website: https://icra-2027-gengenik.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：逆向运动学（IK）是机器人学中的一项基础性操作，它将高层规划器所表达的任务空间目标映射为可实现这些目标的机器人构型。传统IK方法通常将每个查询视为孤立的位姿到构型的求解问题，但规划器往往需要对有效实现方案的分布进行建模，以考虑未来可达性以及避碰、稳定性等偏好。我们提出了GenGenIK，一种生成式建模方法，在统一接口下支持移动基座、多末端执行器与多目标、场景感知以及对机器人行为的偏好设置。实验表明，GenGenIK在双臂抬升和翻转等任务中，在求解成功率和运行时间两方面均优于现有方法，同时能够灵活控制采样分布，并在部分场景观测条件下保持有效。网站：https://icra-2027-gengenik.github.io/。

Authors: Kaitlyn Zhang, Tomás Lozano-Pérez, Leslie Pack Kaelbling

Reading the Table: Sim-to-Real Game State Detection for the Chef's Hat Card Game Perception3D

synthetic data domain randomization object detection segmentation game state detection

简要说明：本文提出了一种全自动合成数据收集管线，利用域随机化训练目标检测和分割模型，实现人类形机器人NICO在Chef's Hat纸牌游戏中的卡牌区域分配，F1分数达0.906。

TLDR: The paper presents a fully automated synthetic data collection pipeline with domain randomization to train object detection and segmentation models for card-to-zone assignment in the Chef's Hat card game, enabling a NICO humanoid robot to perceive game state with an F1-score of 0.906.

Abstract: Tabletop games offer a compelling scenario to study the interaction between artificial and human agents, combining social interaction with game state tracking and physical manipulation. To assess the game state, a robot needs to precisely detect closely related game objects, such as different card designs, requiring dedicated training data that is costly to annotate in the real world. Instead, we develop a fully automated synthetic data collection pipeline, using re-projection of known 3D coordinates to generate labels automatically and domain randomization to bridge the reality gap. This approach is used to collect a dataset of 25413 samples to finetune an object detection and a segmentation model, which are combined to assign detected cards to game-relevant zones and infer the game state. When evaluated on a real NICO humanoid robot, our pipeline achieves an F1-score of 0.906 for card-to-zone assignment, thus providing the perceptual foundation for a robot that can autonomously play Chef's Hat against human players.

摘要（中文）：桌面游戏为研究人工智能体与人类智能体之间的交互提供了一个引人入胜的场景，它将社交互动与游戏状态追踪及物理操作融为一体。为了评估游戏状态，机器人需要精确检测紧密相关的游戏对象，例如不同的卡牌图案，这要求专门的训练数据，而在现实世界中标注这些数据的成本高昂。为此，我们开发了一条全自动的合成数据采集流程，利用已知三维坐标的重投影自动生成标签，并通过域随机化来弥合现实差距。该方法被用于采集包含25413个样本的数据集，以微调目标检测模型和分割模型，两者结合后将检测到的卡牌分配到游戏相关区域，并推断游戏状态。在真实的NICO人形机器人上评估时，我们的流程在卡牌到区域分配任务上达到了0.906的F1分数，从而为能够自主与人类玩家进行Chef's Hat游戏的机器人奠定了感知基础。
